svg.aria-label: State diagram: Robot 1 + CNC (Setup 2, dual gripper A / B)
svg.text: State diagram: Robot 1 + CNC (Setup 2, dual gripper A / B)
Gripper A carries the raw part, gripper B the finished part. The raw part is picked while the CNC is still machining.

g.text: Home robot · check CNC ready, door closed
CAM-1 pick pose · gripper A picks
Hold the raw part at the door-ready pose
while the CNC finishes the cycle
Empty gripper B grips the handle, slides
B grips finished part · vise opens · lift ·
air blast · A places raw part · clamp
Empty gripper A slides the door closed,
Send CYCLE START · CNC idle time ends
Wait for ENC-43 = 0 and CP-2 entry clear
From any state: timeout or a

svg.text: F FAULT and H HOLD can be entered from any state. FAULT = a confirmation is missing or a timeout
expired (the alarm names the sensor, no automatic robot retries). HOLD = LINE STOP from the cross-check
supervisor: the current step is finished, the robot parks, and it resumes at the same step after the reset.

text.tspan: Robot home · CNC ready · door closed

gripper A open · R1 clear of CNC
ZS-32 door closed = ON · ZS-33 locked
